decision.explanation: The sources present two conflicting claims regarding Willy Schwabacher's education. Document 1 (D1S2) explicitly states he attended the 'University of Nottingham' during his undergraduate years. Document 2 (D2S4 and D2S9) explicitly states he attended the 'Technical University of Darmstadt'. Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers when competing assertions exist without resolving them as errors, both institutions are included as supported by their respective source segments.
